risk-1.description: Only tests, scripts, CI, documentation or benchmark harnesses changed; no production or build-input change.

risk-2.description: Traced prover-only or other non-verifier production code in any path; dependency-only bumps outside the verifier closure. Traced prover-only level 2 is honored regardless of path.

risk-3.description: Dependency-only bumps in the verifier closure, or scoped indirect shared-code changes outside the risk-4 path hints. Model level 3 on a risk-4-hint path becomes 4; traced prover-only level 2 stays 2. AFFECTS/UNCERTAIN at effective risk-3 stays 3 only up to max_changed_lines added plus removed runtime-code lines across all effective-level-3 paths, excluding lockfiles and deterministic bumps; non-Rust files count every non-blank line. Larger changes are risk-4.

risk-4.description: Verifier logic/preprocessing, proof encoding/format, transcript/Fiat-Shamir, protocol, sumcheck order/expressions or PCS parameters. On these paths model level 3 becomes 4, while traced prover-only level 2 stays 2; level 1 needs the cfg(test)/comment exception. The bounded shared-code exception applies only outside these risk-4 hints. Non-minimal AFFECTS/UNCERTAIN or unclassified changes are 4. Requires current-head maintainer approval.
